title: Because the Two of Us Can Run at Full Throttle

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today is the Event-Specific Athletic Meet,
where students can freely choose their events and race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As usual, many visitors have come to the academy, filling the campus with lively buzz.
Yet, shouting loud enough to cut through all the commotion is—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Gaaahhhhhhh!!
I wanna run alreadhyyyyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
You bet! It's the perfect chance to show everyone
the results of the training we did together!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I entered the 1,700m turf race, and it looks like
a bunch of girls who've already debuted are running too, but...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
What do you call this again?
A pre... pre... pre-what?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: A prelude.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
YES, THAAAT!!
Wait, Hayahide! Good morning!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Good morning. You are certainly full of energy, Ticket.
It is good to see you are poised to run at full strength without nerves.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, yeah!!
After all, I've got my Trainer by my side!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer, let me introduce you! Hayahide is my classmate!!
She's super-duper smart!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
And if Hayahide is here, that means,
ummmmm...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there she is!! TAISHIIIIIIIN!!
Come over heeeerrrre!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...! Stop shouting in that deafening voice, idiot!!
Everyone around us is staring now...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, sorry, sorry! But I'm so happy to see you two!!
Hayahide's race is this afternoon, so I didn't think you'd be here this morning!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Indeed. I wanted to see your run as well.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Gaaahhh! Thank you soooo much!!
I'll give it everything I've gottt!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
So, what about you, Taishin... Wait, huh?
Didn't you say you weren't interested in school events and were gonna ditch?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...I was just taking a walk and passing by.
It's noisy, annoying people are here, so I'm heading back.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
No waaaay?!
Taishin... You're already leaving...?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna run my heart out, so please watch my race!
Don't say such sad things! Waaaaaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Oh, give it a rest! Quit crying all the time, it's exhausting...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Anyway, I'm heading out.
See ya.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Aaaahhh! TAISHIIIIIIN!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Worry not, Ticket.
Taishin was walking toward the spectator stands.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Huh, really?! Tai... Tai... TAISHIIIIIIN!
Your clumsy, awkward friendship touches my soouuulll!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And with that heartwarming scene behind us...
the time had finally come for Winning Ticket's race.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
TRAAAIINEEERRRR!!
I'm finally up next!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Having such an amazing Trainer by my side...
I'b... I'b juzt zzooo...! *hic*!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
...No, no, no, no!!
Before the tears start, there's something I gotta tell you!!
choice_data_list: Something you want to tell me?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
You see! ...I haven't even once run a race
that could truly give dreams to everyone watching.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
But you know what?! Ever since I met you, and we trained together,
and I learned so many things... right now... right now, I...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Nggghhh, AAAAAHHHHHH!!
I can't find the woooords!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Sorry! The rest... I'll tell you through my race!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*CLANG!!*)

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
And they're off for the 1,700-meter turf race! What kind of performance
will these aspiring star horsegirls show us today?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah, haah...!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Winning Ticket pushes out to the front!
A powerful yet remarkably composed stride!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
(Huh...? Huh, wait a sec...!?
What is this? It feels so weird...!!)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
(Is it 'cause we've been together all this time, and you taught me so much...?
'Cause of all the talks I had with Trainer every single day...?)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
('Stay calm and watch your surroundings.' 'Pace yourself.'
'Run your own race.' ...It's like I can hear Trainer's voice!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... Her running's totally changed.
When did she learn to do that...?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Incredible...!
Heh, looks like you found a wonderful Trainer, Ticket!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: (I hear you... I hear you loud and clear, Trainer!)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
—The final stretch!! This is it, right?!
FULL THROTTLE, GOOOOOOOO!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Winning Ticket kicks into gear!!
She's tearing away from the pack!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Here comes Ticket!! Ticket charges ahead!!
What an unbelievable final burst of speed!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: RAAAAAAAAAAAAGGGHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
And across the finish line! Winning Ticket takes first place!
What a magnificent victory!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOAHHH...!!)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: THANK YOU FOR CHEERING, EVERYBOOODY!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Ticket! Congrats!!
That was one incredible run!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
*sniffle* Thank you, thank you sooo much!
I'm the happiest horsegirl in the whoooole woooorld!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
To pay you all back... one day, I promise
I'll become a horsegirl who gives dreams to everyone!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
So right here, right now, to all of you... and to the Trainer
who taught me how to run, I make this solemn vow!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna become—
a DERBY WINNER, DAMMITTTTT!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: (YEAAAAAAAHHHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unlike during the debut selection race—
not a single soul present doubted her words.
